entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2026-10-21
entry.content:
Google.Cloud.VertexAI.Extensions version 1.0.0-beta10

Bug fixes

  • Also handle a null ThoughtSignature
  • Send the thought signature of non-function parts in PredictionServiceChatClient

Google.Cloud.ModelArmor.V1 version 1.1.0

New features

  • Expose data_residency_compliant field for Model Armor v1 templates
  • Introduce FilterVersionSelector and FilterVersionConfig to specify filter versions
  • Add McpServerFloorSetting for Google MCP Server integrations
  • Add file_label to ByteDataItem for file identification

Documentation improvements

  • Update comment for field filter_results in SanitizationResult
  • Clarify source_language usage in MultiLanguageDetectionMetadata
  • Expand description for ListLocations method

Google.Cloud.Spanner version 5.13.0-beta13

New features

  • Expose allowed_processing_units in InstanceConfig

Google.Cloud.RapidMigrationAssessment.V1 version 1.4.0

New features

  • Deprecate Google.Cloud.RapidMigrationAssessment.V1

Google.Cloud.Dialogflow.V2 version 4.34.0

New features

  • Expose ResponseMessage, AutomatedAgentReply.response_messages, and Message.response_messages in Dialogflow v2
  • Expose AutomatedAgentReply intent, event, match_confidence, parameters, and call_companion_auth_code in Dialogflow v2
  • Add disable_interim_input_transcripts to InputAudioConfig, SpeechToTextConfig, and VoiceSessionConfig in Dialogflow v2
  • Expose SentimentAnalysisResult.status in Dialogflow v2

Bug fixes

  • Remove model_id from SpeechToTextConfig.GeminiAsrConfig in Dialogflow v2

Documentation improvements

  • Clarify customer_satisfaction summarization section documentation
